scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.sw.json && vite build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project 'accessibility-*' --project 'interaction-*' --project 'security-*' --project 'seo-*' --project 'worker-*'" && npm run test:rules && npm run test:client && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:accessibility: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project 'accessibility-*'"
scripts.test:client: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project 'client-*'"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang "FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR=true playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project functions"
scripts.test:interaction: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project 'interaction-*'"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,database,storage --project demo-come-hang "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project rules"
